messages.author: 20c6dbb46920d12c
messages.subject: Re: how to plot geom_bar in white and black and make white bars visible when the background is also white
parts:
In addition to the fill parameter, you just need to also specify the colour parameter (black in this case):

ggplot(dat,aes(x=alm.fij,fill=alm.loc)) + geom_bar(position = "dodge",colour="black") +

scale_fill_manual("Location",
                   values = c('white','black'),
            breaks = c('Michoacán', 'Jalisco'))

Adam Loveland
